name: RadialDamageData
lifetime: Lua wrapper is mutable before dispatch; retention after RadialDamage is unproven
notes: Creates the outgoing radial-damage packet used by Mallet.

name: IsNull
lifetime: No lifetime ownership; null test only
notes: Use before dereferencing borrowed engine objects.

name: UpgradedValue
lifetime: Temporary value wrapper; post-dispatch retention unproven
notes: Accepted by RadialDamageData:SetBaseAmount in stock Mallet.

name: SetSource
lifetime: Packet-local reference valid for dispatch
notes: Source attribution field.

name: SetOrigin
lifetime: Value copied or retained for dispatch; exact ownership unproven
notes: Mallet supplies its pulse origin.

name: SetBaseAmount
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Configures attempted radial damage before per-target application.

name: SetDamagePct
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet uses damage type 7 at fraction 1.

name: SetSourceObject
lifetime: Borrowed source-object reference for dispatch
notes: Do not use Lua wrapper identity as a universal hit discriminator.

name: SetDamageCallback
lifetime: Target is a borrowed engine object valid during the synchronous callback; retention after callback is unproven
notes: Argument 1 unwraps to the damaged AvatarOrEntity native object and argument 2 is the engine-reported numeric damage result. The callback Lua wrapper does not expose IsDead on the tested RifleLancerAvatar path; do not assume the full ordinary Avatar Lua method table. Callback may run multiple times for one radial dispatch.

name: RadialDamage
lifetime: Consumes or reads packet during dispatch; asynchronous retention unproven
notes: Engine owns victim selection and the complete Mallet pulse radius.

name: DamageControl
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned handle; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: Used to read and update caster Overguard.

name: GetOverguardAmount
lifetime: Value result; receiver is engine-owned
notes: Returns the current Overguard amount observed by the script.

name: SetOverguardAmount
lifetime: Receiver is borrowed; write applies to current avatar state
notes: Absolute setter, not an additive grant. Clamp and preserve larger pre-existing pools in Lua.

name: GetPlayer
lifetime: Opaque borrowed handle; exact concrete type unresolved
notes: Only the composition GetPlayer -> NotifyOverguardGain argument 1 is confirmed.

name: NotifyOverguardGain
lifetime: Arguments consumed during call; retention unproven
notes: Pass the positive delta, not the new absolute pool value.

name: GetAvatarOwner
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned avatar reference; reacquire after ability or avatar lifecycle changes
notes: Stock Mallet calls this with zero explicit arguments on the exact creator ability used as RadialDamageData source, then uses the result as the caster. Null behavior is not proven; callers must guard with IsNull.

name: AddModifiers
lifetime: Mutates temporary UpgradedValue
notes: Stock Mallet applies its modifier table before SetBaseAmount.

name: GetLocalizeTag
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned tag wrapper; consume immediately
notes: The target addon uses the returned tag only to match the currently queried ability.

name: c_str
lifetime: String value is consumed during the current comparison
notes: Confirmed only as the immediate GetLocalizeTag to c_str comparison used by the Mallet matcher.

name: ModifyValue
lifetime: Mutates the temporary UpgradedValue; engine objects are borrowed
notes: The four-argument shape is confirmed for this Mallet path. Selector 10 remains scope-bound and is not a universal Strength enum.

name: radius
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Outer radial pulse radius; not equivalent to a Lua FindAll snapshot centered on the Mallet ball.

name: horizontalImpulse
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet value is 100 in the inspected build.

name: verticalImpulse
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet value is 33.333333333333336 in the inspected build.

name: ignoreEntity
lifetime: Borrowed packet reference
notes: Entity excluded by the stock packet.

name: checkForCover
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet sets true.

name: staticCoverOnly
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet sets true.

name: fallOff
lifetime: Packet-local value
notes: Stock Mallet sets zero in the inspected path.

name: GetCreator
lifetime: No ownership transfer proven; orphan/nil case unseen
notes: ZERO explicit arguments at every rendered corpus site (receiver excluded). Object-like/reference behavior proven (member calls and field reads on the result). Exact native type unresolved; nil-orphan behavior unresolved.

name: GetUniquePowerIdentifier
lifetime: Unknown
notes: ZERO explicit arguments. Opaque pass-through value only: no corpus site lengthens, concatenates, or decomposes it. Earlier string/lengthable claims RETRACTED in R5 v3; exact native type unknown.

name: GetAllAttachments
lifetime: Snapshot semantics unproven
notes: Exactly ONE explicit argument at ALL 190 rendered corpus sites (zero zero-arg sites). Iterable/list-like result proven by generic-for and ipairs consumption; element type UNRESOLVED; filter semantics UNRESOLVED; nil-versus-empty UNRESOLVED.

name: DistanceToPoint
lifetime: No side effects observed
notes: Exactly ONE explicit point/reference argument (not two numbers). Luau-facing NUMBER proven by ordered-comparison sites (NullStar <=), literal-threshold comparisons, and numeric-context feeds (Vector Z). Exact C++ scalar width/type unresolved.

name: GetWeaponInSlot
lifetime: Miss/nil behavior UNPROVEN
notes: Observed one-explicit-argument shape retained. Mock object-or-nil behavior is NOT promoted to native truth: return type and miss behavior remain unresolved pending independent stock/native/live evidence.

name: GetLocalPlayerAvatar
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned avatar reference; reacquire after avatar or region lifecycle changes
notes: ZERO explicit arguments. Live use returned the current Octavia avatar. Exact concrete avatar subtype and behavior when no local avatar exists remain unresolved; guard with IsNull before dereference.

name: AddGravityMultiplier
lifetime: Keyed modifier persists through the tested interval; stock and live use -1 until matching-key removal
notes: Exactly THREE explicit arguments. Stock and live evidence confirm that multiplier 0 with duration -1 produces persistent zero gravity. Nonzero multiplier behavior, duration units, other negative durations, and the full accepted key-type family are unresolved.

name: RemoveGravityMultiplier
lifetime: Removes the gravity modifier associated with the matching key
notes: Exactly ONE source-visible argument. Use the same key passed to AddGravityMultiplier. Encoded open-argument sites do not establish another source-level overload; return value is unobserved.

name: PushChildMovie
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned movie; close it on setup failure or through the UI lifecycle
notes: Exactly ONE explicit movie-resource argument in the stock TopMenu/LotusUtilities Generic Settings paths and the live-accepted RENOVICE bridge. The result is null-checked before use. Exact native ownership and failure reasons remain unresolved.

name: Execute
lifetime: No ownership transfer proven
notes: The preserved bridge uses exactly TWO explicit arguments for Generic Settings setters, matching the inspected stock UI paths. This contract covers that two-argument form only; other Execute overloads remain unresolved.

name: Close
lifetime: Invalidates or begins closing the borrowed child movie
notes: ZERO explicit arguments in the inspected stock and RENOVICE failure-cleanup paths. Timing of final destruction and repeated-close behavior remain unresolved.

name: HasArgs
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned argument container; no ownership transfer
notes: The pinned census has 62 zero-explicit-argument, one-result sites and every result is consumed as a boolean branch. The synchronized ability map resolves 55 of 56 receivers to SecondaryScriptArgs; the remaining site preserves the same construction/value flow but lacks a rendered receiver label.

name: EnableJump
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned InputControl; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census has 60 one-explicit-argument, zero-result sites. All 57 synchronized ability-corpus receivers resolve to InputControl; 55 pass literal booleans and two pass a parameter also used through boolean negation.

name: EnableCrouch
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned InputControl; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census has 54 one-explicit-argument, zero-result sites. All 50 synchronized ability-corpus receivers resolve to InputControl; 48 pass literal booleans and two pass a parameter also used through boolean negation.

name: SetForceWalk
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned MotionControl; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census has 10 one-explicit-argument, zero-result method sites. All 11 synchronized ability method calls resolve to MotionControl and preserve literal or boolean-flow arguments; one separate global-function call with the same text is excluded.

name: SetStopMovement
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned InputControl; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census has seven one-explicit-argument, zero-result sites. All five synchronized ability-corpus receivers resolve to InputControl and pass literal booleans. Runtime transition timing is not live-proven.

name: SetWeaponsEnabled
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned InventoryControl; reacquire after avatar or loadout lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census and synchronized ability corpus each have 10 one-explicit-argument, zero-result sites. All synchronized receivers resolve to InventoryControl; nine calls pass literal booleans and one passes the same boolean flow used by adjacent movement toggles.

name: SetAbilitiesEnabled
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned PowerSuit; reacquire after suit or avatar lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census has 12 one-explicit-argument, zero-result sites. All 11 synchronized ability-corpus receivers resolve to PowerSuit and every argument is a literal boolean.

name: RemoveAllProcs
lifetime: Borrowed engine-owned DamageControl; reacquire after avatar lifecycle changes
notes: The pinned census has 32 zero-explicit-argument, zero-result sites. In the synchronized ability corpus, 29 of 30 receivers resolve directly to DamageControl and the remaining frame value is assigned from DamageControl before use. Which proc classes are removed and replication behavior remain unresolved.

name: GetMission
lifetime: Borrowed mission descriptor owned by the current game rules; consume fields during the current mission lifecycle
notes: Sixty-one sites across exact Mobile Defense, Territory, and Excavation modules use zero explicit arguments and one closed result. Mobile Defense prototype 22 instruction 118 reads difficulty and maxWaveNum from the result, and the target addon reuses the same game-rules receiver observed at instruction 139. Exact native descriptor class and behavior outside an active mission remain unresolved.
